error.description: Short error identifier. Usually the standard reason phrase; domain errors use a code, e.g. step_up_required.

message.description: Human-readable message. An array when request validation failed, one entry per constraint.
message.example: Please re-verify your identity to continue.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

fullName.description: User's full name (Apple only sends this on first sign-in)

identityToken.description: Apple identity token (JWT) from the native sign-in flow

body.description: The optional free-text note, if the sender added one

fromYou.description: Whether you are the sender of this message

active.description: Whether this check-in is active right now

preparationMinutes.description: Minutes the user needs to get ready before heading out

CheckInMotivation.description: Registry §30. The last motivation accepted with Continue, which pre-selects the step; null on a first Check-In.

startsAt.description: The instant the hour starts. The client works it out from the device clock and the 7am day boundary; the server drops an hour that has already started.

tier.description: preferred: the 1st tap. available: the 2nd tap.

CheckInSlotTier.description: preferred: the 1st tap. available: the 2nd tap.

active.description: Whether the current window holds a committed Check-In. True unlocks date search; false is the "date search not available" Search tab.

filters.description: The filter settings the Filters step opens with: the saved ones, or -- for a user with none yet -- the first-Check-In pre-fill from the profile (story 05), any age, 10 km.

filtersSaved.description: Whether `filters` are saved settings rather than the profile pre-fill.

firstCheckIn.description: True until the user has committed a Check-In once.

introPassed.description: Whether the intro CTA has ever been tapped. The gate reopens at Today once it has, at the intro before that.

lastMotivation.description: Registry §30. The last motivation accepted with Continue, which pre-selects the step; null on a first Check-In.

lastVibes.description: Registry §31, in list order. The last vibes accepted with Continue; empty on a first Check-In.

windowId.description: The current Check-In window -- `window_id` on every Check-In event. Null only before profile creation is complete; one opens then and lasts 48 hours.

CheckInVibe.description: Registry §31, in list order. The last vibes accepted with Continue; empty on a first Check-In.

district.description: The neighbourhood the phone's own geocoder names for that place, shown next to the distance on Search. Trimmed; empty is no district. Never geocoded by the server.

latitude.description: Where the phone is, if location is allowed. Sent with longitude or not at all.

longitude.description: Where the phone is, if location is allowed. Sent with latitude or not at all.

slots.description: Today and Tomorrow, every picked hour with its tier.

uplift.description: The reason to be picked: at most 100 characters (graphemes), never an email, a phone number or a link. Trimmed; empty is stored as no uplift.

windowId.description: The window the flow ran in. The commit is idempotent per window: a retry never creates a second Check-In. If it has expired, the Check-In goes into the current window.

rating.description: Your rating of the date, from 1 to 5

targetUserId.description: The id of the user to block

availabilityEnd.description: ISO 8601 end of the availability window

availabilityStart.description: ISO 8601 start of the availability window

latitude.description: Latitude of the person's location at check-in, read from the device (−90..90). Required — a location is mandatory to check in. Used only to find nearby people and to pick a nearby venue; never shown to others, who receive a rounded distance instead. This is not a meeting place the person chooses: the venue for a date is selected by the backend and recommended to both people.

longitude.description: Longitude of the person's location at check-in, read from the device (−180..180). Required, together with latitude.

preparationMinutes.description: Minutes the user needs to get ready before heading out (15–60). Defaults to 30 if omitted. Used with travel time to check a date is reachable.

message.description: The optional message, at most 100 characters. Trimmed; empty or whitespace only is no message. Any sender may write one; only a Premium recipient can read it.

position.description: The profile's 1-based position in this Search visit, for like_sent's payload

targetUserId.description: The id of the user being liked

context.description: Where the report is made from

dateId.description: The date this report relates to

lateness.description: Required only when the reason is "showed up late".

reportedUserId.description: The id of the user being reported

otherConfirmedHappened.description: Whether the other person has confirmed the date happened

otherUserId.description: The other person on this date

venueId.description: The suggested venue, if one was chosen

youConfirmedHappened.description: Whether you have confirmed the date happened

DatingLanguage.description: The languages someone is happy to date in (registry §1 dating_language). Send at least one; stored de-duplicated and in list order, whatever order is sent.

token.description: The device push token to remove

DevicePermissionStatus.description: enums.json §24. restricted is parental controls or MDM, treated as denied.

distanceMeters.description: Distance from the viewer, rounded (never exact coordinates)

gender.description: Null when unanswered, or when the person has chosen not to show it on their profile

maxAge.description: The oldest age to see, or null for 65+ -- no upper limit.

meetGender.description: Registry §10 meet_gender, the §1 gender set: who they want to meet. At least one. Class 2 -- never in a tracking payload.

FlowPosition.description: The §2 step just completed or skipped. Only ever moves forward: an earlier step is accepted and ignored, so going back a screen never rewinds the account.

FutureFamily.description: Registry §4 family_ahead. May be empty (walked past without an answer); stored de-duplicated and in list order. An exclusive value combined with another is refused.

FutureLiving.description: Registry §4 living_ahead. May be empty (walked past without an answer); stored de-duplicated and in list order. An exclusive value combined with another is refused.

FuturePartnership.description: Registry §4 partnership_ahead. May be empty (walked past without an answer); stored de-duplicated and in list order. An exclusive value combined with another is refused.

idToken.description: Google ID token from the native sign-in flow

InterestTag.description: Registry §3 interest tags, the "What I am into" chips. Between one and ten; stored de-duplicated and in list order, whatever order is sent.

LifeFamily.description: Registry §4 family. May be empty (walked past without an answer); stored de-duplicated and in list order. An exclusive value combined with another is refused.

LifeLiving.description: Registry §4 living. May be empty (walked past without an answer); stored de-duplicated and in list order. An exclusive value combined with another is refused.

LifePartnership.description: Registry §4 partnership. May be empty (walked past without an answer); stored de-duplicated and in list order. An exclusive value combined with another is refused.

matchId.description: The match id, when a match was created

matched.description: True if this like completed a mutual match

otherUserId.description: The other person in the match

previewSource.description: Section 22: `ranked` or `fallback`. `ranked` came from the completion ranking; `fallback` means the ranking had no publishable answer and the section-20 cold-start prompt was used. A string rather than an enum for the same reason as the two above -- anything a client does not recognise is read as `fallback`.

previewVideo.description: The prompt previewed on an empty video card. A section-20 `media_prompt_id`; clients that do not recognise it fall back to the cold-start prompt.

previewVoice.description: The prompt previewed on an empty voice card. A section-20 `media_prompt_id`; clients that do not recognise it fall back to the cold-start prompt.
